newsitem.title: UK: UK engineering, aerospace stocks push higher.
newsitem.headline: UK engineering, aerospace stocks push higher.

text.p: UK engineering and aerospace stocks pushed higher on Tuesday on what dealers called an acceleratation of the resurgent interest in the sector.
"We've had a few good pieces of news recently -- GKN's helicopter deal, bullish outlooks for LucasVarity -- and that has helped speed up interest," one dealer said.
The sector was led higher on Tuesday by Smiths Industries, up 14p at 806-1/2p, GKN, up 16p at 1,137-1/2p and Vickers, up 11p at 294-1/2p.
British Aerospace was up seven pence at 1,063-1/2p while LucasVarity gained 1-1/2p to 256p.
Dealers said engineering and aerospace stocks were undergoing a bear squeeze, pointing to recent underperformance.
"It's been picking up over the last few weeks. Volumes are nothing spectacular but demand has been steady," one said.
Others said there was some optimism that the manufacturing and engineering sector would be least affected by a potential change of government in the UK.
Some investors had booked profits on utilities, which were sold on worries of a windfall tax threatened by the opposition Labour Party, and switched into the engineering sector.
